mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.business_id AS businessId, b.name AS businessName, o.total_amount AS totalAmount, o.paid_amount AS paidAmount, o.paid_quantity AS paidQuantity, o.total_amount - COALESCE(o.paid_amount, 0) AS remainAmount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity), 0) FROM shipment_item i WHERE i.order_id = o.id AND i.deleted = 0) - COALESCE(o.paid_quantity, 0) AS remainQuantity, o.ship_date AS shipDate, o.remark, o.create_time AS createTime, o.update_time AS updateTime, CASE WHEN o.total_amount IS NULL OR o.total_amount <= 0 THEN 0 WHEN o.paid_amount >= o.total_amount THEN 2 WHEN o.paid_amount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS status, DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), o.ship_date) AS overdueDays FROM shipment_order o LEFT JOIN base_business b ON o.business_id = b.id AND b.deleted = 0 WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.id = #{id}
